extraction: orch-fix-defect: reproduce as failing regression test → fix to green → review → gated commit. Maps to Verdict→Miss loop: Verdict writes fix spec as 'failing test' (e.g., 'Santali CER must drop from 53.91 to < 50'), Miss implements fix (engine config, preprocessing), Verdict re-verifies (runs test). Max 2 fix-loop rounds. Fix spec IS the test — no separate test writing needed.
